summary: The default-capacity case executed but failed for a harness reason, and the diagnosis is recorded: its own operands show nodes_parked 1 with decided_before = decided_after = 1030, although a quorum (the healthy leader plus the other live follower) was still available — progress stopped because each sender's single forwarding task blocks awaiting delivery into the parked node's full incoming channel, stalling that sender's unrelated traffic too. The harness now uses per-destination queues with one delivery task per destination, so a parked destination accumulates into its own queue and cannot block anyone else; the same correction also removes that confound from the cluster-level case in the same harness. This revision re-requests the retained run of the corrected harness (four cases unchanged, parameters unchanged). Locally all four pass with the corrected transport in 11.5s, the default-capacity case reporting event_capacity 1024, nodes_parked 2, decided_before = decided_after = 1119 and append_notify_timeout_reached true, so the last stated limitation of the event finding (bound witnessed only at 64/8, default argued from source) should be resolvable from the incoming receipt. The three findings and their current accounts are otherwise unchanged; the case-4 failure is a probe failure, not target evidence, and no interpretation cites it.
